title: Verizon delivers extra value with free safety, family and AI perks
summary: Verizon highlights built-in family safety tools, a Google AI Pro promotion and Loyalty program perks included at zero extra cost for customers
body_markdown:
A million hearts connected: Celebrating a milestone of peace of mind with Verizon Family


Verizon Family is your all-in-one safety hub for families on the move. From teens driving solo to children walking home, the service provides location sharing, arrival alerts and digital boundaries.


[Products & plans](https://www.verizon.com/about/news-category/products-plans)


Verizon breaks industry mold to put customers first


Verizon cuts fees, launching "Simplicity" ($45/line) and "Verizon One" ($70 mobile+home bill). Its new loyalty program offers 3% cash back and "Shine" daily rewards for all.


[Products & plans](https://www.verizon.com/about/news-category/products-plans)


Verizon says “We Got You” this Cybersecurity Awareness Month


Introducing new security solutions, including Digital Secure Home and a refreshed Verizon Protect App, for more control over your home, devices and digital life.


[Products & plans](https://www.verizon.com/about/news-categories/products-plans)
